# Rear bumper hitch integration for spare tires

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Tuck the rear bumper hitch receiver inward to avoid leg strikes. [t1638]

## Tips & gotchas

- Tucking the hitch improves departure angle but may require a different spare tire setup. [t1638]
- [Partial] A standard bumper with a spare underneath requires an extending hitch. [t1638]
